card.fires_on: Words where the next word could plausibly be "input", such as "low" in "low-input", "energy" before "intensive", or "fertilizer" before "rates" in farming and energy text. It also fires on some stray spots like a comma or the end of "HEMATOLOGIC".

modes.label: Inputs in fertilizer or energy
modes.description: Nouns or modifiers in phrases about inputs, intensity or rates of resources.

modes.label: Odd stray positions
modes.description: Capitalized or punctuation spots in unrelated text with no clear link to input.
